training: Natural documents 0–31, all 4096 positions, including inactive gates as zero. No evaluation fitting.
baseline: Unconditional per-group/component mean decoded direction, normalized to oracle recipient norm; zero means stay zero.
control: Recipient coordinates permuted by fixed CPU torch randperm seed 51001, same permutation for every candidate and unit; preserves norm.
evaluation: M50 eligible unique prefixes, unchanged donor mapping. Local squared vector error, zero predictor=1. Not native response fidelity.
selection: All eight frozen M38 models, all three components; no search.
